_note: Te Reo Māori — DELIBERATELY PARTIAL. Only short, standard phrases are translated here; every longer string is left in English on purpose. Te reo is a taonga and an official language of Aotearoa, and machine-translated or non-speaker te reo on a church's own words about faith would be worse than leaving the English in place. The /mi/ pages carry a visible note saying so, and invite speakers to help finish it. Certified translators: tetaurawhiri.govt.nz
